pages.recipe:
Dinner · one pan

Sheet-pan chicken & vegetables

Everything on one tray, 35 minutes, and the leftovers make tomorrow's lunch.

10prep min
25cook min
4servings
$$cost
  1. Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes and carrots into 2 cm pieces.
  2. Toss with oil, salt and garlic on a large tray. Roast 10 minutes.
  3. Add chicken thighs, skin up, and roast 25 minutes until browned and 75°C inside.
  4. Rest 5 minutes and spoon the pan juices over everything.

Ingredients

  • 8 chicken thighs
  • 600 g potatoes
  • 4 carrots
  • 3 tbsp olive oil
  • 4 garlic cloves

Is the planner saved?

It's saved in your browser only. Clear your data and it's gone.

Yes. Use your browser's print and it will fit one page.

Do you cater for allergies?

Each recipe lists its main allergens. Filters for common allergens are on the way.
